name: Rust Clippy Check
description: Runs cargo clippy on Rust files after Claude edits them to catch common mistakes
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Run cargo clippy after editing Rust files
FILE="$TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"
if [[ "$FILE" =~ \.rs$ ]]; then
  if command -v cargo &>/dev/null; then
    cargo clippy --quiet 2>/dev/null
    if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
      echo "Clippy found issues. Review warnings above."
    fi
  else
    echo "cargo not found, skipping clippy check"
  fi
fi
exit 0
